verdict.rationale: Pomelo's AI features in the evidence are an assistant that answers questions about the Pomelo API and an MCP server that finds endpoints and generates code samples. Neither produces insights or suggestions from the customer's own card or transaction data. The Dashboard monitoring feature is documented, but nothing indicates it is AI-generated, so it is only an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
